globalThis.comparison=(()=>{

  ({p,a,b,c}=setup());const fragment=document.createDocumentFragment();const x=document.createElement('u');x.textContent='x';fragment.appendChild(x);fragment.appendChild(new Text('y'));b.before(fragment);result.fragment=text(p)==='axybc' && fragment.childNodes.length===0 && x.parentNode===p;p.remove();

  ({p,a,b,c}=setup());try{b.before(a,{toString(){throw new Error('conversion');}});}catch{}result.conversionAtomic=text(p)==='abc' && a.parentNode===p;p.remove();
